## What it is

The plain disc that threads the four arc notches. Outside Ø73.77, hole Ø68.97, 1.2 mm thick, 2.4 mm wide. No tabs. It sits on the spine.

## Design notes

- The notch is the same arc, 0.15 mm larger each side, 1.3 mm deep. The disc top is flush with the towers. 0.1 mm of air is under the disc.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 1.2
```

## Don't

- Don't print it standing on edge. 1.2 mm on its side is a ribbon.
